supplemental_languages.classification_note: Added as a documented DRC language profile outside the original 47 CongoLangBench tracks. Kinyabwisha is kept as a related North Kivu variety note, not collapsed into the language identifier.

records.evidence_locator: Masisi table: Kinyarwanda, 15%
records.limitations: The source reports the percentage of the population speaking the language; it does not measure proficiency, first-language identity, or exclusive territorial distribution.

records.evidence_locator: Nyiragongo table: Kinyarwanda, 60%
records.limitations: The source reports the percentage of the population speaking the language; it does not measure proficiency, first-language identity, or exclusive territorial distribution.

records.evidence_locator: Rutshuru table: Kinyabwisha, 70%; source note identifies it as a mutually intelligible dialect of Kinyarwanda
records.limitations: The source labels the reported variety Kinyabwisha. It states mutual intelligibility with Kinyarwanda, but the atlas does not treat the two labels as identical. The percentage does not measure proficiency.
